item.description: Ukraine confirms it struck Russia’s Kalibr armed Naro Fominsk corvette near Gogland Island yesterday. Finland earlier reported a strike in the Gulf of Finland without providing details. Estonia too confirms, adding the likely damaged ship headed for St. Petersburg.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

Ukraine confirms it struck Russia’s Kalibr armed Naro Fominsk corvette near Gogland Island yesterday. Finland earlier reported a strike in the Gulf of Finland without providing details. Estonia too confirms, adding the likely damaged ship headed for St. Petersburg.

item.description: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta and SpaceX’s AI division face a lawsuit filed by nonprofit groups in San Francisco seeking to halt development of advanced AI models. The plaintiffs, Reuters reports, allege the technology poses “catastrophic risks,” thus violating California law.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta and SpaceX’s AI division face a lawsuit filed by nonprofit groups in San Francisco seeking to halt development of advanced AI models. The plaintiffs, Reuters reports, allege the technology poses “catastrophic risks,” thus violating California law.
